_comment: Deployment settings. This is the one file you edit to point the system at your
own Box content. Everything else in the repo is design and process.
AGENT.md tells ChatGPT to read this before choosing any logo.

_what: The Box folder holding approved customer logos. This is the ONLY source the
agent may take a logo from. ChatGPT reads it through your Box connector, so
the account ChatGPT is connected as must be able to open this folder.
_howToFindTheId: Open the folder in Box in a browser. The address bar reads
The trailing number IS the folder ID. Paste it below as a string.
The ID is what the Box connector uses to list contents, so it is the most
reliable of the three fields here - fill this one in if you fill in nothing else.
_path: Not used to find the folder - it is printed in the sheet plan so you can see
at a glance which folder the agent looked in. Optional but useful.
_sharedLink: Optional fallback: a Box shared link (https://app.box.com/s/...) created from
the folder's Share menu. Use only if the folder ID does not work - a shared
link is a different access path and the connector may not resolve it.

_ifTheFolderIsEmpty: If folderId is blank, or ChatGPT cannot reach the folder, AGENT.md tells it to
say so and ask you to name the companies you want shown, rather than sourcing
logos from anywhere else. The system still works - it just asks.
